title: Purifying selection on noncoding deletions of human regulatory loci detected using their cellular pleiotropy.
authors: Radke, David W; Sul, Jae Hoon; Balick, Daniel J; Akle, Sebastian; Green, Robert C; Sunyaev, Shamil R
one_liner_zh: 该文通过统计方法分析非编码缺失的纯化选择与染色质调控元件，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Genomic deletions provide a powerful loss-of-function model in noncoding regions to assess the role of purifying selection on genetic variation. Regulatory element function is characterized by nonuniform tissue and cell type activity, necessarily linking the study of fitness consequences from regulatory variants to their corresponding cellular activity. We generated a callset of deletions from genomes in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) and used deletions from The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium (1000GP) in order to examine whether purifying selection preserves noncoding sites of chromatin accessibility marked by DNase I hypersensitivity (DHS), histone modification (enhancer, transcribed, Polycomb-repressed, heterochromatin), and chromatin loop anchors. To examine this in a cellular activity-aware manner, we developed a statistical method, pleiotropy ratio score (PlyRS), which calculates a correlation-adjusted count of "cellular pleiotropy" for each noncoding base pair by analyzing shared regulatory annotations across tissues and cell types. By comparing real deletion PlyRS values to simulations in a length-matched framework and by using genomic covariates in analyses, we found that purifying selection acts to preserve both DHS and enhancer noncoding sites. However, we did not find evidence of purifying selection for noncoding transcribed, Polycomb-repressed, or heterochromatin sites beyond that of the noncoding background. Additionally, we found evidence that purifying selection is acting on chromatin loop integrity by preserving colocalized CTCF binding sites. At regions of DHS, enhancer, and CTCF within chromatin loop anchors, we found evidence that both sites of activity specific to a particular tissue or cell type and sites of cellularly pleiotropic activity are preserved by selection.
abstract_zh: 基因组缺失为非编码区域提供了一个强大的功能缺失模型，用以评估纯化选择对遗传变异的作用。调控元件的功能以非均匀的组织和细胞类型活性为特征，这必然将调控变异对适应性后果的研究与其相应的细胞活性联系起来。我们从阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）的基因组中生成了一个缺失调用集，并利用来自千人基因组计划联盟（1000GP）的缺失，以检验纯化选择是否保护由DNase I超敏位点（DHS）、组蛋白修饰（增强子、转录、Polycomb抑制、异染色质）和染色质环锚点标记的染色质可及性非编码位点。为了以细胞活性感知的方式检验这一点，我们开发了一种统计方法，即多效性比率评分（PlyRS），通过分析跨组织和细胞类型的共享调控注释，为每个非编码碱基对计算相关性调整的“细胞多效性”计数。通过将真实缺失的PlyRS值与长度匹配框架中的模拟进行比较，并在分析中使用基因组协变量，我们发现纯化选择作用于保护DHS和增强子非编码位点。然而，我们没有发现纯化选择对非编码转录、Polycomb抑制或异染色质位点超出非编码背景的证据。此外，我们发现有证据表明纯化选择通过保护共定位的CTCF结合位点来作用于染色质环完整性。在染色质环锚点内的DHS、增强子和CTCF区域，我们发现特定组织或细胞类型特有的活性位点以及细胞多效性活性位点均受到选择的保护。
